description: This file defines React components for the landing page sections of a web application, including FeaturesSection, SecuritySection, and PricingSection, along with some auxiliary components like FeatureCard, SecurityRow, and ModeRow. It imports various external libraries such as React, react-router-dom, framer-motion, and fontawesome for icons and animations.

methods.name: FeatureCard
methods.description: A functional component that displays a feature icon, title, and description within a styled card.

methods.name: SecurityRow
methods.description: A component that displays a security feature with an icon, title, and description.

methods.name: ModeRow
methods.description: A component to show different security modes with their details.
